# TekDivas

> TekDivas builds complete digital branding for growing businesses — custom websites, smart features, and ongoing support that turn visitors into customers.

## About
TekDivas is a web/software development studio serving local service businesses and non-technical business owners. Services include website development, custom software, and AI agent integration.

## Services
- Website Development
- Custom Software
- AI Agent Services
